examples.text: kiñ'ca, bhikkhave, jātidhammaṃ vadetha? puttabhariyaṃ, bhikkhave, jātidhammaṃ, dāsidāsaṃ jātidhammaṃ, aj'eḷakaṃ jātidhammaṃ, kukkuṭasūkaraṃ jātidhammaṃ
itthikumārikapaṭiggahaṇā paṭivirato hoti, dāsidāsapaṭiggahaṇā paṭivirato hoti

32401.commentary: (MNa) dāsidāsapaṭiggahaṇā'ti ettha dāsidāsavasen'eva tesaṃ paṭiggahaṇaṃ na vaṭṭati, kappiyakārakaṃ dammi, ārāmikaṃ dammī'ti evaṃ vutte pana vaṭṭati.

examples.text: itthikumārikapaṭiggahaṇā paṭivirato ahosiṃ, dāsidāsapaṭiggahaṇā paṭivirato ahosiṃ, aj'eḷakapaṭiggahaṇā paṭivirato ahosiṃ, kukkuṭasūkarapaṭiggahaṇā paṭivirato ahosiṃ

32402.meaningLit: discourse on female and male slaves

32403.meaning1: son of a female slave; son of a servant

examples.text: porāṇaṃ kho pana te ambaṭṭha mātāpettikaṃ nāmagottaṃ anussarato ayyaputtā sakyā bhavanti, dāsiputto tvam'asi sakyānaṃ. sakyā kho pana, ambaṭṭha, rājānaṃ okkākaṃ pitāmahaṃ dahanti.

32404.meaning2: (use of) the word 'son of a slave'

examples.text: evaṃ vutte, te māṇavakā bhagavantaṃ etadavocuṃ, mā bhavaṃ gotamo ambaṭṭhaṃ atibāḷhaṃ dāsiputtavādena nimmādesi.

32405.meaning1: as a slave woman; as a servant
32405.meaningLit: with the function of a slave woman
32405.commentary: (VINa) tato aparena dāsibhogenā'ti mās'ātikkame yena bhogena dāsī bhuñjitabbā hoti khettakamma-kacavarachaḍḍana-udakāharaṇ'ādinā, tena bhuñjiṃsu.

examples.text: te evarūpāya tiracchānavijjāya micchājīvena jīvitaṃ kappenti, seyyath'idaṃ… usulakkhaṇaṃ dhanulakkhaṇaṃ āvudhalakkhaṇaṃ itthilakkhaṇaṃ purisalakkhaṇaṃ kumāralakkhaṇaṃ kumārilakkhaṇaṃ dāsalakkhaṇaṃ dāsilakkhaṇaṃ hatthilakkhaṇaṃ assalakkhaṇaṃ
vedehikāya kho pana, bhikkhave, gahapatāniyā kāḷī nāma dāsī ahosi dakkhā analasā susaṃvihitakamm'antā.
itthikumārikapaṭiggahaṇā paṭivirato hoti dāsidāsapaṭiggahaṇā paṭivirato hoti

32410.commentary: (ADht) yathā kathaṃ viyā'ti āha dāv'aggi viyā'ti. so hi vanaghaṭe'y'eva uppanno tam'eva dahati.

examples.text: satthā mahābhikkhusaṅghaparivāro aññatarasmiṃ padese aṭṭhāsi. dāv'aggi abhibhavanto viya viravanto āgacchati.
yathā vā pana, mahārāja, brāhmaṇamāṇavakānaṃ… bhūmikampaṃ disādāhaṃ bhumm'antalikkhaṃ jotisaṃ lok'āyatikaṃ sācakkaṃ migacakkaṃ antaracakkaṃ missak'uppādaṃ sakuṇarutaravitaṃ sikkhā karaṇīyā
āyatanaghaṭṭanato phasso jāyati araṇisahit'ābhimanthanato aggi viya. phassena phuṭṭhassa vedanā pātubhavati agginā phuṭṭhassa dāho viya. vedayamānassa taṇhā pavaḍḍhati loṇ'ūdakaṃ pivato pipāsā viya.
gandho isīnaṃ ciradikkhitānaṃ, kāyā cuto gacchatu mālutena, vicitrapupphaṃ surabhiṃ'va mālaṃ, gandhañ'ca etaṃ pāṭikaṅkhāma bhante, na h'ettha devā paṭikkūlasaññino.
325, 348. saṅkhyāpubbo digu.
digussa samāsassa ekattaṃ hoti, napuṃsakaliṅgattañ'ca.
ucc'āvacā hi paṭipadā, samaṇena pakāsitā, na pāraṃ diguṇaṃ yanti, na'y'idaṃ ekaguṇaṃ mutaṃ.

32422.commentary: (SNa) bahun'eke na dicchare'ti bahunā'pi bhogena samannāgatā ekacce na dadanti.

examples.text: appasm'eke pavecchanti, bahun'eke na dicchare, appasmā dakkhiṇā dinnā, sahassena samaṃ mitā'ti.

32423.synonym: aṇḍaja, pakkhī, vihaga, vihaṅga, vihaṅgama, sakuṇa

examples.text: kadā mayūrassa sikhaṇḍino vane, dijassa sutvā girigabbhare rutaṃ, paccuṭṭhahitvā amatassa pattiyā, saṃcintaye taṃ nu kadā bhavissati.
ye nāgarāje sahasā haranti, dibbā dijā pakkhi visuddhacakkhū, vehāsayā te vanam'ajjhapattā, citrā supaṇṇā iti tesa nāmaṃ.

32425.commentary: (VVt) dijānaṃ gaṇā dijagaṇā, nānā ca te dijagaṇā cā'ti nānādijagaṇā

examples.text: umāpupphena samānā, gaganā'v'abbhachāditā, nānādijagaṇ'ākiṇṇā, te selā ramayanti maṃ.

32426.meaning1: with twice born, even, bright, clean, shining teeth
32426.constructionSummary: dija + sama + sukka + suci + sobhana + danta
32426.construction: dija + sama + sukka + suci + sobhana + danta
32426.commentary: (DNa) dijasamasukkasucisobhanadanto'ti dve vāre jātattā dijanāmakā sukkā suci sobhanā ca dantā assā'ti dijasamasukkasucisobhanadanto.
32426.sanskrit: dvija + sama + śukra, śukla + śuci + śobhana + danta

examples.text: taṃ veyyañjanikā samāgatā bahavo, byākaṃsu nipuṇasammatā manujā, sucijanaparivāragaṇo bhavati, dijasamasukkasucisobhanadanto.

32427.meaning1: seen, heard and sensed; seen, heard and perceived
32427.commentary: (VIN) diṭṭhaṃ nāma cakkhunā diṭṭhaṃ. sutaṃ nāma sotena sutaṃ. mutaṃ nāma ghānena ghāyitaṃ, jivhāya sāyitaṃ, kāyena phuṭṭhaṃ.

examples.text: n'āhaṃ sabbe samaṇabrāhmaṇāse, jātijarāya nivutā'ti brūmi, ye s'īdha diṭṭhaṃ'va sutaṃ mutaṃ vā, sīlabbataṃ vā'pi pahāya sabbaṃ, anekarūpam'pi pahāya sabbaṃ, taṇhaṃ pariññāya anāsavāse, te ve narā oghatiṇṇā'ti brūmi.
sa sabbadhammesu visenibhūto, yaṃ kiñci diṭṭhaṃ va sutaṃ mutaṃ vā, tam'eva dassiṃ vivaṭaṃ carantaṃ, ken'īdha lokasmi vikappayeyya.
gahakāraka diṭṭho'si, puna gehaṃ na kāhasi, sabbā te phāsukā bhaggā, gahakūṭaṃ visaṅkhataṃ, visaṅkhāragataṃ cittaṃ, taṇhānaṃ khayamajjhagā.
ahañ'hi, bho gotama, evaṃvādī evaṃdiṭṭhī, yo koci diṭṭhaṃ bhāsati, evaṃ me diṭṭhan'ti, n'atthi tato doso

32429.commentary: (SNa) diṭṭhe diṭṭhamattan'ti rūp'āyatane cakkhuviññāṇena diṭṭhe diṭṭhamattaṃ bhavissati. cakkhuviññāṇañ'hi rūpe rūpamattam'eva passati, na nicc'ādisabhāvaṃ, iti sesaviññāṇehi'pi me ettha diṭṭhamattam'eva cittaṃ bhavissatī'ti attho. atha vā diṭṭhe diṭṭhaṃ nāma cakkhuviññāṇaṃ, rūpe rūpavijānanan'ti attho.

examples.text: yato kho te bāhiya diṭṭhe diṭṭhamattaṃ bhavissati sute sutamattaṃ bhavissati mute mutamattaṃ bhavissati viññāte viññātamattaṃ bhavissati tato tvaṃ bāhiya na tena
ahañ'hi, bho gotama, evaṃvādī evaṃdiṭṭhī, yo koci diṭṭhaṃ bhāsati, evaṃ me diṭṭhan'ti, n'atthi tato doso

32430.commentary: (NIDD1) diṭṭhena saṃsuddhi narassa hotī'ti. cakkhuviññāṇaṃ rūpadassanena narassa suddhi visuddhi parisuddhi, mutti vimutti parimutti hoti, naro sujjhati visujjhati parisujjhati, muccati vimuccati parimuccatī'ti, diṭṭhena saṃsuddhi narassa hoti.

examples.text: passāmi suddhaṃ paramaṃ arogaṃ, diṭṭhena saṃsuddhi narassa hoti, ev'ābhijānaṃ paraman'ti ñatvā, suddh'ānupassī'ti pacceti ñāṇaṃ.

32431.synonym: appiya, amitta, ari, disa, paccatthika, paccāmitta, paṭisattu, viddesī, sattar, sattu, sapatta
32431.commentary: (JAa) diṭṭhan'ti paccāmittaṃ. so ativattatī'ti yassa puggalassa yathā tava, evaṃ ete cattāro dhammā atthi, so yathā maṃ ajja tvaṃ atikkanto, tath'eva attano paccāmittaṃ atikkamati abhibhavatī'ti.

examples.text: yass'ete ca tayo dhammā, vānar'inda yathā tava, dakkhiyaṃ sūriyaṃ paññā, diṭṭhaṃ so ativattatī'ti.

32434.meaning1: fact of being seen; fact of being visible; fact of being understood

32435.meaning2: benefit pertaining to the present life

32436.meaning1: this life; this world; the here and now

examples.text: imesañ'ca catunnaṃ jhānānaṃ ābhicetasikānaṃ diṭṭhadhammasukhavihārānaṃ nikāmalābhī bhavissasi akicchalābhī akasiralābhī
idha pana, bhikkhave, ekaccassa puggalassa tādisaṃ'y'eva appamattakaṃ pāpakammaṃ kataṃ diṭṭhadhammavedanīyaṃ hoti, n'ānu'pi khāyati, kiṃ bahu'd'eva.

32437.meaning1: who has seen the Dhamma; who has perceived reality
32437.meaning2: who has realized the final truth

examples.text: atha kho brahm'āyu brāhmaṇo diṭṭhadhammo pattadhammo viditadhammo pariyogāḷhadhammo tiṇṇavicikiccho vigatakathaṃkatho vesārajjappatto aparappaccayo satthusāsane bhagavantaṃ etadavoca

32438.meaning1: Nibbāna in this life; complete cooling in the present existence
32438.commentary: (MNa) diṭṭhadhammanibbānaṃ vā'ti iminā pañca diṭṭhadhammanibbānavādā kathitā. tattha diṭṭhadhammo'ti paccakkhadhammo vuccati, tattha tattha paṭiladdhaattabhāvass'etaṃ adhivacanaṃ. diṭṭhadhamme nibbānaṃ diṭṭhadhammanibbānaṃ, imasmiṃ'y'eva attabhāve dukkhavūpasaman'ti attho.

examples.text: sato vā pana sattassa ucchedaṃ vināsaṃ vibhavaṃ paññapenti, diṭṭhadhammanibbānaṃ vā pan'eke abhivadanti.

32439.meaning1: attained Nibbāna in this very life; whose fire has gone out here and now

examples.text: jarāmaraṇassa ce, āvuso, bhikkhu nibbidā virāgā nirodhā anupādā vimutto hoti, diṭṭhadhammanibbānappatto bhikkhū'ti alaṃ vacanāya.

32441.meaning1: doctrine of total emancipation in this life itself
32441.meaning2: (proponent of the) doctrine of total emancipation in this life itself
32441.commentary: (PMa) diṭṭhadhammo'ti paccakkhadhammo, tattha tattha paṭiladdha-attabhāvass'etaṃ adhivacanaṃ. diṭṭhadhamme nibbānaṃ diṭṭhadhammanibbānaṃ, imasmiṃ'y'eva attabhāve dukkhavūpasamo'ti attho, taṃ vadantī'ti diṭṭhadhammanibbānavādā.

examples.text: apar'ant'ānudiṭṭhiyā katamehi catucattālīsāya ākārehi abhiniveso hoti? soḷasa saññīvādā, aṭṭha asaññīvādā, aṭṭha n'evasaññī-n'āsaññī-vādā, satta ucchedavādā, pañca diṭṭhadhammanibbānavādā, apar'ant'ānudiṭṭhiyā imehi catucattālīsāya ākārehi abhiniveso hoti.

32442.meaning1: holding the doctrine of total emancipation in this life itself
32442.meaning2: holding the doctrine of total emancipation in this life itself
32442.commentary: (DNa) diṭṭhadhammanibbānavāde diṭṭhadhammo'ti paccakkhadhammo vuccati, tattha tattha paṭiladdhattabhāvass'etaṃ adhivacanaṃ. diṭṭhadhamme nibbānaṃ diṭṭhadhammanibbānaṃ, imasmiṃ'y'eva attabhāve dukkhavūpasamanan'ti attho. taṃ vadantī'ti diṭṭhadhammanibbānavādā. paramadiṭṭhadhammanibbānan'ti paramaṃ diṭṭhadhammanibbānaṃ uttaman'ti attho.

examples.text: santi, bhikkhave, eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā diṭṭhadhammanibbānavādā sato sattassa paramadiṭṭhadhammanibbānaṃ paññapenti pañcahi vatthūhi.

32444.meaning1: comfortable existence in this very life; pleasant way to pass the time here and now

examples.text: taṃ t'āhaṃ, bhikkhu, evaṃ vadāmi, iṅgha tvaṃ, mārisa, app'ossukko diṭṭhadhammasukhavihāram'anuyutto viharassu, anakkhātaṃ kusalañ'hi, mārisa, mā paraṃ ovadāhī'ti.
yato ca kho, bhikkhave, bhikkhu… catunnañ'ca jhānānaṃ ābhicetasikānaṃ diṭṭhadhammasukhavihārānaṃ nikāmalābhī hoti akicchalābhī akasiralābhī… evaṃ so ten'aṅgena paripūro hoti.

32445.meaning1: enjoying a comfortable existence here and now; pursuing a pleasant life in this very world

examples.text: taṃ t'āhaṃ, bhikkhu, evaṃ vadāmi, iṅgha tvaṃ, mārisa, app'ossukko diṭṭhadhamma-sukhavihāram'anuyutto viharassu, anakkhātaṃ kusalañ'hi, mārisa, mā paraṃ ovadāhī'ti.

32446.meaning1: to be felt in this life; to be experienced here and now

examples.text: evarūpassa, bhikkhave, puggalassa tādisaṃ'y'eva appamattakaṃ pāpakammaṃ kataṃ diṭṭhadhammavedanīyaṃ hoti, n'āṇu'pi khāyati, kiṃ bahu'd'eva.

puna capar'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, te nigaṇṭhe evaṃ vadāmi, taṃ kiṃ maññath'āvuso nigaṇṭhā, yam'idaṃ kammaṃ diṭṭhadhammavedanīyaṃ taṃ upakkamena vā padhānena vā samparāyavedanīyaṃ hotū'ti labbham'etan'ti? no h'idaṃ, āvuso.

32447.meaning1: for the sake of welfare in this life; for benefit in this world
32447.construction:
diṭṭha + dhamma + hita + attha + āya
diṭṭhadhammahitattha + āya
32447.commentary: (JAa) diṭṭhadhammahit'atthāyā'ti imasmiṃ'y'eva attabhāve hit'atthāya ca paraloke sukh'atthāya ca hotī'ti.

examples.text: diṭṭhadhammahit'atthāya, samparāyasukhāya ca, kat'āvakāsā pucchāma, yaṃ kiñci abhipatthitan'ti.

32448.meaning1: attained perfection and mastery of direct knowledge in this very life
32448.commentary: (MNa) diṭṭhadhamm'ābhiññā-vosāna-pāramippattā'ti diṭṭhadhamme abhiññāte imasmiññ'eva attabhāve abhijānitvā vositavosānā hutvā pāramīsaṅkhātaṃ sabbadhammānaṃ pārabhūtaṃ nibbānaṃ pattā mayan'ti vatvā ādibrahmacariyaṃ paṭijānantī'ti attho.
32448.sanskrit: dṛṣṭadharma + abhijñā + vi + avasāna + pārami + prāpta

examples.text: ekam'antaṃ nisinno kho saṅgāravo māṇavo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca, santi kho, bho gotama, eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā diṭṭhadhamm'ābhiññā-vosāna-pāramippattā, ādibrahmacariyaṃ paṭijānanti.

32449.meaning1: completely quenched in this life; perfectly extinguished here and now
32449.meaning2: completely calmed in this life; perfectly extinguished here and now
32449.commentary: (ANa) diṭṭhadhamm'ābhinibbutā'ti diṭṭhadhamme imasmiṃ'y'eva attabhāve sabbakilesanibbānena nibbutā. (SNPa) diṭṭhadhamm'ābhinibbutā'ti viditadhammattā, diṭṭhadhammattā, rāg'ādi-nibbānena ca abhinibbutā. sesaṃ sabbattha pākaṭam'eva.

examples.text: etadaññāya ye satā, diṭṭhadhamm'ābhinibbutā, upasantā ca te sadā, tiṇṇā loke visattikan'ti.
te appamattā sukhino, diṭṭhadhamm'ābhinibbutā, sabbaverabhay'ātītā, sabbadukkhaṃ upaccagun'ti.

32450.meaning1: concerning this life; regarding this world; relevant to here and now

examples.text: duve imā cakkhumatā pakāsitā, nibbānadhātū anissitena tādinā, ekā hi dhātu idha diṭṭhadhammikā, saupādisesā bhavanettisaṅkhayā, anupādisesā pana samparāyikā, yamhi nirujjhanti bhavāni sabbaso.
atha kho brahm'āyussa brāhmaṇassa etadahosi, kat'āvakāso kho'mhi samaṇena gotamena. kiṃ nu kho ahaṃ samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ puccheyyaṃ, diṭṭhadhammikaṃ vā atthaṃ samparāyikaṃ vā'ti.

32451.meaning1: in this life and the next; here and hereafter

32452.meaning1: suffering in this life and the next

32453.meaning1: concerning benefit in this life and the hereafter

32454.meaning1: striving in the present; making an effort here and now

examples.text: sace, bhikkhave, sattā diṭṭhadhamm'ūpakkamahetu sukhadukkhaṃ paṭisaṃvedenti, addhā, bhikkhave, nigaṇṭhā evarūpā diṭṭhadhamm'ūpakkamā yaṃ eta'r'ahi evarūpā dukkhā tibbā kaṭukā vedanā vediyanti.

32455.meaning1: due to striving in the present; because of exertion here and now

examples.text: sace, bhikkhave, sattā diṭṭhadhamm'ūpakkamahetu sukhadukkhaṃ paṭisaṃvedenti, addhā, bhikkhave, nigaṇṭhā evarūpā diṭṭhadhamm'ūpakkamā yaṃ eta'r'ahi evarūpā dukkhā tibbā kaṭukā vedanā vediyanti.

32457.meaning1: who has seen the way; who has seen the state (of Nibbāna)

examples.text: kiñ'c'āpi so kamma karoti pāpakaṃ, kāyena vācā uda cetasā vā, abhabba so tassa paṭicchadāya, abhabbatā diṭṭhapadassa vuttā, idam'pi saṅghe ratanaṃ paṇītaṃ, etena saccena suvatthi hotu.
diṭṭhapubbo pana te, bhikkhu, so bhagavā, disvā ca pana jāneyyāsī'ti? na kho me, āvuso, diṭṭhapubbo so bhagavā, disvā c'āhaṃ na jāneyyan'ti.

32459.meaning1: who has attained vision (of Nibbāna); epithet of a stream-enterer
32459.commentary: (ADha) diṭṭhaṃ viditaṃ sacchikataṃ passitaṃ paññāyā'ti diṭṭhappatto. ayam'pi kāyasakkhī viya chabbidho'va hoti.

32460.meaning2: who believes in auspicious things seen

32461.meaning1: merely the seen; only what is seen; sight itself

examples.text: ettha ca te, māluṅkyaputta, diṭṭhasutamutaviññātabbesu dhammesu diṭṭhe diṭṭhamattaṃ bhavissati, sute sutamattaṃ bhavissati, mute mutamattaṃ bhavissati, viññāte viññātamattaṃ bhavissati.

32463.meaning1: perceiving as seen; thinking one has seen (something)
32463.commentary: (VINa) adiṭṭhe diṭṭhasaññino'ti arahatte ñāṇacakkhunā adiṭṭhey'eva, diṭṭhaṃ amhehi arahattan'ti diṭṭhasaññino hutvā. esa nayo appatt'ādīsu.

examples.text: tena kho pana samayena sambahulā bhikkhū adiṭṭhe diṭṭhasaññino apatte pattasaññino anadhigate adhigatasaññino asacchikate sacchikatasaññino adhimānena aññaṃ byākariṃsu. tesaṃ aparena samayena rāgāya'pi cittaṃ namati dosāya'pi cittaṃ namati mohāya'pi cittaṃ namati.

32464.meaning1: who has found calm; who has realized peace

32465.meaning2: comparing one's view on things seen or known

examples.text: udabindu yathā'pi pokkhare, padume vāri yathā na limpati, evaṃ muni n'opalimpati, yadidaṃ diṭṭhasutaṃ mutesu vā.
ubhosu antesu vineyya chandaṃ, phassaṃ pariññāya anānugiddho, yadattagarahīī tadakubbamāno, na lippatī diṭṭhasutesu dhīro.

32467.meaning2: visible audible feelable and knowable; seen, heard, felt and known
32467.compound: dvanda (diṭṭha ca suta ca muta ca viññāta ca)

examples.text: idha diṭṭhasutamutaviññātesu, piyarūpesu hemaka, chandarāgavinodanaṃ, nibbānapadam'accutaṃ.

32468.meaning1: visible, audible, sensible and knowable; which can be seen, heard, sensed and known
32468.meaningLit: to be seen heard sensed and known
32468.compound: dvanda (diṭṭha ca suta ca muta ca viññātabba ca)
32468.commentary: (MNa) diṭṭha-suta-muta-viññātabba-saṅkhāra-mattenā'ti diṭṭhaviññātabbamattena sutaviññātabbamattena mutaviññātabbamattena. ettha ca vijānātī'ti viññātabbaṃ, diṭṭha-suta-muta-viññātabba-mattena pañcadvārikasaññā-pavatti-mattenā'ti ayañ'hi ettha attho.

examples.text: ettha ca te, māluṅkyaputta, diṭṭhasutamutaviññātabbesu dhammesu diṭṭhe diṭṭhamattaṃ bhavissati, sute sutamattaṃ bhavissati, mute mutamattaṃ bhavissati, viññāte viññātamattaṃ bhavissati.

ye hi keci, bhikkhave, samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā diṭṭha-suta-muta-viññātabba-saṅkhāra-mattena etassa āyatanassa upasampadaṃ paññapenti, byasanañ'h'etaṃ, bhikkhave, akkhāyati etassa āyatanassa upasampadāya.

32469.meaning1: mere visible, audible, sensible and knowable conditions; just fabrications which can be seen, heard, sensed and known
32469.commentary: (MNa) diṭṭha-suta-muta-viññātabba-saṅkhāra-mattenā'ti diṭṭhaviññātabbamattena sutaviññātabbamattena mutaviññātabbamattena. ettha ca vijānātī'ti viññātabbaṃ, diṭṭha-suta-muta-viññātabba-mattena pañcadvārikasaññā-pavatti-mattenā'ti ayañ'hi ettha attho.
32469.sanskrit: dṛṣṭa + śruta + mata + vijñātavya + saṃskāra + mātra

examples.text: ye hi keci, bhikkhave, samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā diṭṭha-suta-muta-viññātabba-saṅkhāra-mattena etassa āyatanassa upasampadaṃ paññapenti, byasanañ'h'etaṃ, bhikkhave, akkhāyati etassa āyatanassa upasampadāya.

32470.commentary: (NIDD2) diṭṭhassuten'āpi vadanti suddhin'ti diṭṭhena'pi suddhiṃ visuddhiṃ parisuddhiṃ muttiṃ vimuttiṃ parimuttiṃ vadanti kathenti bhaṇanti dīpayanti voharanti, sutenapi suddhiṃ visuddhiṃ parisuddhiṃ muttiṃ vimuttiṃ parimuttiṃ vadanti kathenti bhaṇanti dīpayanti voharanti, diṭṭhassutena'pi suddhiṃ visuddhiṃ parisuddhiṃ muttiṃ vimuttiṃ parimuttiṃ vadanti kathenti bhaṇanti dīpayanti voharantī'ti, diṭṭhassuten'āpi vadanti suddhiṃ.

examples.text: ye kec'ime samaṇabrāhmaṇāse, diṭṭhassuten'āpi vadanti suddhiṃ, sīlabbatenāpi vadanti suddhiṃ, anekarūpena vadanti suddhiṃ, kacci'ssu te bhagavā tattha yatā carantā, atāru jātiñ'ca jarañ'ca mārisa, pucchāmi taṃ bhagavā brūhi me taṃ.

32471.meaning1: who speaks about the seen; who states what one has seen (as)
32471.commentary: (MNa) diṭṭhe diṭṭhavāditā'ti-ādīsu yāya cetanāya diṭṭhe diṭṭhaṃ me'ti vadati, sā diṭṭhe diṭṭhavāditā nāma. (DNa) diṭṭhavāditā'ti diṭṭhaṃ mayā'ti evaṃ vāditā.

examples.text: diṭṭhe diṭṭhavāditā, sute sutavāditā, mute mutavāditā, viññāte viññātavāditā, ime kho, āvuso, cattāro vohārā tena bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena samma'd'akkhātā.

aṭṭh'ime, bhikkhave, ariyavohārā. katame aṭṭha? adiṭṭhe adiṭṭhavāditā, asute asutavāditā, amute amutavāditā, aviññāte aviññātavāditā, diṭṭhe diṭṭhavāditā, sute sutavāditā, mute mutavāditā, viññāte viññātavāditā.

32472.meaning1: who speaks about the seen; who states what one has seen (as)

examples.text: adiṭṭhe diṭṭhavādī hoti, asute sutavādī hoti, amute mutavādī hoti, aviññāte viññātavādī hoti… adiṭṭhe adiṭṭhavādī hoti, asute asutavādī hoti, amute amutavādī hoti, aviññāte aviññātavādī hoti.

te tassa satt'āhassa accayena tiṇagahanā vanagahanā rukkhagahanā nadīviduggā pabbatavisamā nikkhamitvā aññam'aññaṃ āliṅgitvā sabhāgāyissanti samassāsissanti, diṭṭhā, bho, sattā jīvasi, diṭṭhā, bho, sattā jīvasīti.

32474.meaning1: disposition of view; tendency to a belief

examples.text: ath'evaṃ diṭṭh'ādhimuttīnaṃ yathāsatti yathābalaṃ dhammaṃ desetuṃ indriyaparopariyatta-ñāṇena indriyaparopariyattaṃ passati, saddh'ādīnaṃ tikkhamudubhāvadassanato.

32475.commentary: (MNa) diṭṭh'ānugatiṃ āpajjatī'ti dassan'ānugatiṃ paṭipajjati, yan'diṭṭhiko bhavaṃ gotamo yaṃkhantiko yaṃruciko, te'pi tan'diṭṭhikā honti taṃkhantikā taṃrucikā'ti attho.

examples.text: kiñ'c'āpi, bhikkhave, evarūpassa puggalassa na diṭṭh'ānugatiṃ āpajjati, atha kho naṃ kalyāṇo kittisaddo abbhuggacchati, kalyāṇamitto purisapuggalo kalyāṇasahāyo kalyāṇasampavaṅko'ti.

ye'me, bho gotama, kulaputtā bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ uddissa saddhā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajitā, bhavaṃ tesaṃ gotamo pubbaṅ'gamo, bhavaṃ tesaṃ gotamo bahukāro, bhavaṃ tesaṃ gotamo samādapetā, bhoto ca pana gotamassa sā janatā diṭṭh'ānugatiṃ āpajjatī'ti.

32476.meaning1: underlying tendency towards views; inherent inclination towards opinions; underlying conceptual beliefs

examples.text: es'ev'anto rāg'ānusayānaṃ, es'ev'anto paṭigh'ānusayānaṃ, es'ev'anto diṭṭh'ānusayānaṃ, es'ev'anto vicikicch'ānusayānaṃ, es'ev'anto mān'ānusayānaṃ, es'ev'anto bhavarāg'ānusayānaṃ, es'ev'anto avijj'ānusayānaṃ, es'ev'anto daṇḍ'ādāna-satth'ādāna-kalaha-viggaha-vivāda-tuvaṃtuvaṃ-pesuñña-musāvādānaṃ
kāmarāg'ānusayassa… paṭigh'ānusayassa… diṭṭh'ānusayassa… vicikicch'ānusayassa… mān'ānusayassa… bhavarāg'ānusayassa… avijj'ānusayassa pahānāya samucchedāya brahmacariyaṃ vussati.

32477.commentary: (PM) kati diṭṭh'ābhinivesā'ti tīṇi sataṃ diṭṭhābhinivesā. (ANt) diṭṭhi'y'eva saccan'tiādi-vasena abhinivisatī'ti diṭṭh'ābhiniveso.

examples.text: kā diṭṭhi, kati diṭṭhiṭṭhānāni, kati diṭṭhipariyuṭṭhānāni, kati diṭṭhiyo, kati diṭṭh'ābhinivesā, katamo diṭṭhiṭṭhānasamugghāto'ti?

keci pana ekattan'ti ekattanayaṃ vadanti nānattan'ti nānattanayaṃ. apare ekattasaññī attā hoti arogo paraṃ maraṇā, nānattasaññī attā hotī'ti evaṃ diṭṭh'ābhinivesaṃ. taṃ sabbaṃ idha n'ādhippetattā ayuttam'eva hoti.

32478.meaning1: openly expressing one's opinion; voicing one's dissent

examples.text: evañ'ca pana, bhikkhave, te bhikkhū tāhi āpattīhi vuṭṭhitā honti, ṭhapetvā thullavajjaṃ, ṭhapetvā gihippaṭisaṃyuttaṃ, ṭhapetvā diṭṭh'āvikammaṃ, ṭhapetvā ye na tattha hontī'ti.

32479.meaning1: view; belief; opinion; concept; theory; attitude; philosophy; credo; creed; dogma

examples.text: na diṭṭhiyā na sutiyā na ñāṇena, mun'īdha nanda kusalā vadanti, visenikatvā anīghā nirāsā, caranti ye te munayoti brūmi.
visenikatvā pana ye caranti, diṭṭhīhi diṭṭhiṃ avirujjhamānā, tesu tvaṃ kiṃ labhetho pasūra, yes'īdha n'atthī param'uggahītaṃ.

yā imā, bhante, anekavihitā diṭṭhiyo loke uppajjanti, attavādapaṭisaṃyuttā vā lokavādapaṭisaṃyuttā vā, ādim'eva nu kho, bhante, bhikkhuno manasikaroto evam'etāsaṃ diṭṭhīnaṃ pahānaṃ hoti, evam'etāsaṃ diṭṭhīnaṃ paṭinissaggo hotī'ti?

32481.meaning1: clinging to views; attachment to beliefs

examples.text: tassa diṭṭhīnaṃ samudayañ'ca atthaṅ'gamañ'ca assādañ'ca ādīnavañ'ca nissaraṇañ'ca yathābhūtaṃ appajānato yo diṭṭhīsu diṭṭhirāgo diṭṭhinandī diṭṭhisneho diṭṭhimucchā diṭṭhipipāsā diṭṭhipariḷāho diṭṭhiajjhosānaṃ diṭṭhitaṇhā sānuseti.

32482.meaning1: stuck in a view; being entrenched in a belief
32482.commentary: (ANa) diṭṭh'ādhiṭṭhānan'ti diṭṭhīnaṃ adhiṭṭhānaṃ, adhiṭhatvā adhibhavitvā pavattāya diṭṭhiyā etaṃ nāmaṃ.

examples.text: yāvatā, āvuso, diṭṭhi yāvatā diṭṭhiṭṭhānaṃ diṭṭhiadhiṭṭhānaṃ diṭṭhipariyuṭṭhānaṃ diṭṭhisamuṭṭhānaṃ diṭṭhisamugghāto, tam'ahaṃ jānāmi tam'ahaṃ passāmi.

32483.meaning1: having views; believing in; holding opinions
32483.meaning2: believing in, having the theory of

examples.text: dujjānaṃ kho etaṃ, poṭṭhapāda, tayā aññadiṭṭhikena aññakhantikena aññarucikena aññatr'āyogena aññatr'ācariyakena, saññā purisassa attā'ti vā, aññā'va saññā añño attā'ti vā'ti.
anuvattakā'ti yaṃdiṭṭhiko so hoti yaṃkhantiko yaṃruciko te'pi taṃdiṭṭhikā honti taṃkhantikā taṃrucikā.

32484.meaning1: wasteland of views; desert of belief

examples.text: idaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, diṭṭhigataṃ diṭṭhigahanaṃ diṭṭhikantāraṃ diṭṭhivisūkaṃ diṭṭhivipphanditaṃ diṭṭhisaṃyojanaṃ

32485.meaning1: cause for views; reason for belief

32486.meaning1: (wrong or false) belief; misconception; theory; dogma; doctrine; speculative view
32486.commentary: (DNa) diṭṭhigatan'ti diṭṭhi'y'eva. yathā gūthagataṃ muttagatan'ti vutte na gūth'ādito aññaṃ atthi, evaṃ diṭṭhi'y'eva diṭṭhigataṃ.

examples.text: idaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, diṭṭhigataṃ diṭṭhigahanaṃ diṭṭhikantāraṃ diṭṭhivisūkaṃ diṭṭhivipphanditaṃ diṭṭhisaṃyojanaṃ
pubb'āsave hitvā nave akubbaṃ, na chandagū no'pi nivissavādī, sa vippamutto diṭṭhigatehi dhīro, na lippati loke anattagarahī.

32490.meaning1: discussion about views as the basis for the cycle of existence

32492.meaning1: jungle of views; impenetrable thicket of beliefs; thick covering of views
32492.commentary: (THa) andhabhūto puthujjano'ti paññācakkhuvekallena avijjandhatāya andhabhūto puthujjano hutvā vanagahanapabbatagahan'ādīni viya duratikkaman'aṭṭhena diṭṭhi'y'eva gahanaṃ diṭṭhigahanaṃ, taṃ pakkhando anupaviṭṭho'ti diṭṭhigahanapakkhando

examples.text: idaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, diṭṭhigataṃ diṭṭhigahanaṃ diṭṭhikantāraṃ diṭṭhivisūkaṃ diṭṭhivipphanditaṃ diṭṭhisaṃyojanaṃ
diṭṭhigahanapakkhando, parāmāsena mohito, asuddhiṃ maññisaṃ suddhiṃ, andhabhūto aviddasu.

ko nāmo ayaṃ, bhante, dhammapariyāyo'ti? tasmā't'iha tvaṃ, ānanda, imaṃ dhammapariyāyaṃ atthajālan'ti'pi naṃ dhārehi, dhammajālan'ti'pi naṃ dhārehi, brahmajālan'ti'pi naṃ dhārehi, diṭṭhijālan'ti'pi naṃ dhārehi, anuttaro saṅgāmavijayo'ti'pi naṃ dhārehī'ti.

32494.meaning1: clinging to views; attachment to beliefs

examples.text: tassa diṭṭhīnaṃ samudayañ'ca atthaṅ'gamañ'ca assādañ'ca ādīnavañ'ca nissaraṇañ'ca yathābhūtaṃ appajānato yo diṭṭhīsu diṭṭhirāgo diṭṭhinandī diṭṭhisneho diṭṭhimucchā diṭṭhipipāsā diṭṭhipariḷāho diṭṭhi'jjhosānaṃ diṭṭhitaṇhā sānuseti.

32495.meaning1: basis for opinion; grounds for view; standpoint for views
32495.commentary: (ANa) yāvatā diṭṭhiṭṭhānan'ti khandhā'pi diṭṭhiṭṭhānaṃ, avijjā'pi, phasso'pi, saññā'pi, vitakko'pi ayonisomanasikāro'pi, pāpamitto'pi, paratoghoso'pi diṭṭhiṭṭhānan'ti evaṃ yattakaṃ aṭṭhavidham'pi diṭṭhiṭṭhānaṃ diṭṭhikāraṇaṃ nāma atthi.

examples.text: attani ca, bhikkhave, attaniye ca saccato thetato anupalabbhamāne, yam'pi taṃ diṭṭhiṭṭhānaṃ, so loko so attā, so pecca bhavissāmi nicco dhuvo sassato avipariṇāmadhammo, sassatisamaṃ tath'eva ṭhassāmī'ti, nan'āyaṃ, bhikkhave, kevalo paripūro bāladhammo'ti?

so suṇāti tathāgatassa vā tathāgatasāvakassa vā sabbesaṃ diṭṭhiṭṭhāna-adhiṭṭhāna-pariyuṭṭhāna-abhinivesa-anusayānaṃ samugghātāya sabbasaṅkhārasamathāya sabb'ūpadhipaṭinissaggāya taṇhākkhayāya virāgāya nirodhāya nibbānāya dhammaṃ desentassa.

32496.meaning1: who has abandoned the basis for opinions; who has given up grounds for view

32499.meaning1: illustrating a theory; illuminating a concept
